obligations.action_summary: Provide a victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning training program that includes the long-term health implications of physical violence including traumatic brain injury.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide a victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning training program designed to develop skills for the response to and investigation of incidents involving domestic violence, sexual crimes, or human trafficking. The training program shall include but not be limited to the following components: the dynamics of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking, including abuser tactics of power and control; danger and lethality factors in domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking cases; the criminal law provisions of the family protection domestic violence intervention act of 1994, chapter 222 of the laws of 1994; how to determine the primary aggressor in a domestic violence incident; the family offenses; the offense of endangering the welfare of a child; the offenses of assault in the first degree, manslaughter in the first and second degrees, criminally negligent homicide, and murder in the second degree, together with the defense of justification and the role of trauma in victims' acts of self-defense; the importance of avoiding expressions of skepticism, victim-blaming, and minimizing of the offense in early communications with victims; how to recognize signs of drug-facilitated sexual assault and preserve crucial evidence thereof; the overlap among domestic violence, sexual assault and human trafficking; victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning in domestic violence, sexual assault, human trafficking, and related cases; the effects of trauma on victims; the long-term health implications of physical violence including, but not limited to, traumatic brain injury; techniques of trauma-informed policing; the resources available to victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking, including shelter and nonresidential services, locating hospital-based sexual assault forensic exams, and domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking emergency resources; and any other training deemed relevant by the commissioner, except that the commissioner may eliminate a training component or replace a training component with an alternative component in order to provide a comprehensive victim-centered, trauma-informed questioning training program.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring a training program for first responders and a public awareness campaign regarding health effects of domestic violence-related traumatic brain injuries

obligations.action_summary: Develop materials regarding afterschool programs including program lists, eligibility requirements, costs, application processes, and provider contact information.
obligations.quote: The department shall, in consultation with the department of youth and community development, develop materials regarding afterschool programs, including but not limited to, afterschool programs funded by the department and those funded by the department of youth and community development.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Electronically distribute afterschool program materials to parents annually by October 1 and update materials by February 1 for programs beginning after October 1.
obligations.quote: The department shall electronically distribute all materials developed pursuant to subdivision [b] a of this section to parents annually by October 1 of each academic year. For any afterschool program beginning after October 1, all materials shall be updated to include such programs and redistributed to parents electronically by February 1 of the same academic school year.
obligations.deadline_text: annually by October 1 of each academic year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Distribute afterschool program materials in hard copy to each school annually by October 1 and update materials by February 1 for programs beginning after October 1.
obligations.quote: The department shall distribute all materials developed pursuant to subdivision [b] a of this section in hard copy to each school for distribution to every student of such school annually by October 1 of each academic year. Schools shall also distribute such materials to any student who transfers into such school after January 15 of the same academic year. For any afterschool program beginning after October 1, all materials shall be updated to include such programs and redistributed to students in hard or digital copy by February 1 of the same academic school year.
obligations.deadline_text: annually by October 1 of each academic year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Make all afterschool program materials available in English, the 9 most common home languages of enrolled students, and additional languages as determined by the department, using plain, simple, and age appropriate language.
obligations.quote: All materials developed pursuant to subdivision [b] a of this section shall use plain, simple, and age appropriate language and shall be made available in English, the 9 most common home languages of students enrolled in schools, and in additional languages as determined by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.action_summary: Ensure materials are provided to all schools in sufficient quantity and made available in school offices, school websites, the department website, and online portals for students and parents.
obligations.quote: The department shall ensure that all materials developed pursuant to subdivision [b] a of this section are provided to all schools in sufficient quantity to satisfy the requirements of subdivision [d] c of this section. Materials shall also be made available (i) in the main or central office of each school; (ii) on each school's individual website, if available; (iii) on the department's website; and (iv) on any online portal for students and parents.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to afterschool programs

obligations.agency_full: the department responsible for enforcement under § 20-1507
obligations.action_summary: Conduct a study of working conditions for food delivery workers including pay, expenses, equipment, hours, mileage, mode of travel, and safety.
obligations.quote: The department shall study the working conditions for food delivery workers. In conducting such study, the department may coordinate with any other agency, organization, or office that can assist in such study. Such study shall include, at minimum, consideration of the pay food delivery workers receive and the methods by which such pay is determined, the total income food delivery workers earn, the expenses of such workers, the equipment required to perform their work, the hours of such workers, the average mileage of a trip, the mode of travel used by such workers, the safety conditions of such workers, and such other topics as the department deems appropriate.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for contracted delivery workers
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.agency_full: the department responsible for enforcement under § 20-1507
obligations.action_summary: Issue orders or subpoenas for production of data and information from delivery services relating to food delivery workers, trip assignments, compensation, and other relevant matters.
obligations.quote: In furtherance of such study, the department may issue orders or subpoenas for the production of data, documents, and other information from a third-party food delivery service or third-party courier service relating to food delivery workers that include, but are not limited to, worker identifiers, information about the times that such workers are available to work for such third-party food delivery service or third-party courier service, the mode of transportation such workers use, how trips are offered or assigned to food delivery workers, the data such service maintains relating to the trips of such workers, the compensation such workers receive from such third-party food delivery service or third-party courier service, any gratuities such workers receive, information relating to both completed and cancelled trips, agreements with or policies covering such workers, contact information of such workers, information relating to the setting of fees paid by food service establishments and consumers, and any other information deemed relevant by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to protections for contracted delivery workers
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.deadline_text: no later than January 1, 2023

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a program to support youth in foster care and youth who have exited foster care

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to establishing a program to support youth in foster care and youth who have exited foster care

obligations.action_summary: Provide luggage to youth in foster care who are entering foster care, moving between placements, or exiting foster care.

obligations.quote: No later than January 31 of each year, ACS shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council regarding its provision of luggage to youth in foster care during the preceding calendar year
obligations.deadline_text: No later than January 31 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of luggage to youth in foster care

obligations.action_summary: Prepare and deliver an annual summary report on investigations, reviews, studies, and audits relating to the police department containing specified information about findings, recommendations, open cases, access denials, and closed cases.
obligations.quote: there shall be an annual summary report on the activities undertaken pursuant to paragraph 1 of subdivision c and paragraph 1 of subdivision d of this section containing the following information: (a) a description of all significant findings from the investigations, reviews, studies, and audits conducted in the preceding year; (b) a description of the recommendations for corrective action made in the preceding year; (c) an identification of each recommendation described in previous annual reports on which corrective action has not been implemented or completed; [and] (d) the number of open investigations, reviews, studies, or audits that have been open, as of the close of the preceding calendar year, for a time period of (1) six months up to and including one year, (2) more than one year up to and including two years, (3) more than two years up to and including three years, and (4) more than three years; (e) the subject matter of each investigation, review, study, or audit relating to the police department that has been open, as of the close of the preceding calendar year, for more than three years; (f) the number of incidents where the police department did not give access to information requested by the commissioner in the performance of the duties described in paragraph 1 of subdivision c of this section, in (1) closed investigations, and (2) investigations that have been open for more than three years; and (g) the number and subject matters of investigations, reviews, studies, and audits relating to the police department that were closed without issuing a report during the preceding calendar year.
obligations.deadline_text: on April 1, 2015 and every April 1 thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to reporting on investigations relating to the police department

obligations.action_summary: Specify by rule the form and manner in which delivery services must provide written statements to contracted delivery workers.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring delivery services to provide contracted delivery workers with information underlying their pay calculations
obligations.committee: Committee on Consumer and Worker Protection

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a feasibility study examining vacant commercial space availability, temporary occupancy periods, financial considerations including rent, coordination with economic opportunity programs, potential financial assistance up to $10,000 for resident-owned businesses, and liability and indemnification requirements.
obligations.quote: The feasibility study required by this section shall examine, among other factors, the availability of vacant commercial space or other appropriate spaces for use by businesses owned by a public housing resident; the appropriate temporary occupancy period of the commercial space; financial considerations, including appropriate rent payments for the use of such space; opportunities for coordination with the economic opportunities programs for residents of the New York city housing authority; the potential for providing financial assistance up to $10,000 to facilitate the establishment, expansion, or growth of some or all such businesses; and potential liability and indemnification requirements in connection with such use of space.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to including grants in the feasibility study on the use on a temporary basis of vacant New York city public housing authority commercial space by resident-owned businesses

obligations.actor_raw: the mayor or an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency: the mayor or an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the mayor or an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor a feasibility study regarding the use on a temporary basis of vacant commercial space at New York city housing authority developments by businesses owned by an authorized public housing resident.
obligations.quote: the mayor or an agency or office designated by the mayor, with the cooperation of the New York city housing authority, shall submit to the speaker of the council and the mayor a feasibility study regarding the use on a temporary basis of vacant commercial space at New York city housing authority developments by businesses owned by an authorized public housing resident of such housing authority.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2027
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a feasibility study for the use on a temporary basis of vacant New York city housing authority commercial space by resident-owned businesses

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a feasibility study for the use on a temporary basis of vacant New York city housing authority commercial space by resident-owned businesses

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, an annual report on the time elapsed to correct violations in residential buildings classified as occupancy group R-2 or R-3.
obligations.quote: No later than July 15 of each year, the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and shall post conspicuously on the department's website, a report on the time elapsed to correct violations in certain residential buildings.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 15 of each year
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring additional documentation when an owner seeks to demolish a building and reporting on the correction of violations

obligations.action_summary: Designate an agency or office to provide centralized support to residents displaced by qualifying events.
obligations.quote: The mayor shall designate an agency or office to provide centralized support to residents displaced by qualifying events.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agency or office designated by the mayor

obligations.quote: The agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b of this section shall establish an email address and telephone number to receive communications from residents displaced by qualifying events. Such email address and telephone number shall be posted online.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Be available by email and telephone to communicate with residents displaced by qualifying events between at least 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. every day except Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays.
obligations.quote: The agency or office shall be available by both email and telephone to communicate, as described in this section, with such residents between at least the hours of 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. every day in the year except Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Respond to inquiries submitted by residents displaced by qualifying events by providing specified information about timelines, agency inspections, vacate orders, permits, return of personal artifacts, assistance programs, and relevant agencies.
obligations.quote: The agency or office shall, in response to inquiries submitted by residents displaced by qualifying events, provide information that may include but need not be limited to: 1. The applicable timeline of services and deadlines following a qualifying event; 2. The status of relevant agency inspections; 3. The status of relevant vacate orders, such as whether a vacate order has been rescinded; 4. The status of permit applications filed by the owner of a relevant building; 5. Whether the owner of a building subject to a vacate order has requested permission from the relevant agency that residents be permitted to return to such building for the purpose of collecting personal artifacts, and, if applicable, whether the relevant agency has granted such permission; 6. Information about assistance offered by not-for-profit organizations or city, state, and federal agencies to residents displaced by a qualifying event, including information about the emergency housing services provided by the department of housing preservation and development; and 7. A summary of relevant agencies and their roles following a qualifying event.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Maintain a record of inquiries and requests for assistance submitted by residents and a record of the response of the agency or office and any relevant agencies to such inquiries or requests.
obligations.quote: Maintaining a record of inquiries and requests for assistance submitted by residents and a record of the response of the agency or office designated pursuant to this subdivision and of any relevant agencies to such inquiries or requests for assistance;
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Gather and maintain the contact information, including phone numbers or email addresses, of residents displaced by a qualifying event.
obligations.quote: Gathering and maintaining the contact information, including, but not limited to, the phone numbers or email addresses, of residents displaced by a qualifying event.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.actor_raw: the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b
obligations.agency: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: the agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Upon rescission of a vacate order by the commissioner of buildings, commissioner of housing preservation and development, or commissioner of any other relevant agency, provide notice of the rescission to the community board, borough president, and council member representing the district, and by email, text message, or phone call to residents displaced by the qualifying event.
obligations.quote: Upon the rescission of a vacate order associated with a qualifying event by the commissioner of buildings, the commissioner of housing preservation and development, or the commissioner of any other relevant agency, the agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b of this section shall provide notice of the rescission of such vacate order to the community board, borough president, and council member representing the district where the qualifying event occurred, and, by email, text message, or phone call, if such contact information is known, to the residents displaced by the qualifying event that gave rise to the vacate order.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to the designation of an office or agency as responsible for assisting residents displaced by an emergency

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules for the implementation of gratuity payment requirements, including specifying the form and manner of the opportunity to pay a gratuity.
obligations.quote: The department may promulgate rules for the implementation of this section, including specifying the form and manner of the opportunity to pay a gratuity pursuant to this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide an opportunity to pay a gratuity before or at the same time an online order is placed

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Provide relocation services to tenants including gathering information about suitable vacant accommodations, making studies and surveys to locate accommodations, and providing facilities for registration of accommodations with the department.
obligations.quote: Such services may be provided as such commissioner may deem necessary, useful or appropriate for the relocation of such tenants, including but not limited to the gathering and furnishing of information as to suitable vacant accommodations, the making of studies and surveys for the purpose of locating such accommodations and the provision of facilities for the registration of such accommodations with the department of housing preservation and development
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Provide temporary housing to tenants applying for relocation services.
obligations.quote: For any tenant applying for relocation services pursuant to subparagraph (v) of this paragraph, such services may also include the provision of temporary housing.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Not impose any deadline or limitation of time in which a tenant may apply for relocation services.
obligations.quote: Such commissioner shall not impose any deadline or limitation of time in which a tenant may apply for relocation services pursuant to subparagraph (v) of this paragraph.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: Upon request from a tenant, relocate the tenant to suitable vacant accommodations in the same community district or an immediately adjacent community district as the building from which the tenant was displaced.
obligations.quote: Upon a request from a tenant applying for relocation services pursuant to subparagraph (v) of this paragraph, such commissioner shall relocate such tenant to suitable vacant accommodations in the same community district, or an immediately adjacent community district, as the building from which such tenant was displaced.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
obligations.action_summary: If suitable vacant accommodations are unavailable in the same or immediately adjacent community districts, relocate the tenant to suitable vacant accommodations in the nearest community district in the same borough where possible.
obligations.quote: If, following such a request, suitable vacant accommodations are unavailable in such same or any immediately adjacent community district, such commissioner shall relocate such tenant to suitable vacant accommodations in the nearest community district in the same borough, where possible.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring tenant relocation services to the same community district, a nearby community district, or the same borough

obligations.action_summary: Investigate deaths of incarcerated individuals in department of correction custody and prepare reports with recommendations about prevention measures.
obligations.quote: the board shall investigate such death and prepare a report about such investigation. Such report shall include any recommendations about measures the department or correctional health services may implement to prevent the circumstances that contributed to the individual's death.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit investigation reports to the department and correctional health services for their review.
obligations.quote: The board shall submit such report to the department and correctional health services for review by the department and correctional health services pursuant to subdivision h of section 9-171 of the administrative code.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post investigation reports and departmental responses on the board's website no later than 30 days after the department and correctional health services respond.
obligations.quote: No later than 30 days after the board submits the report to the department and correctional health services, the board shall post such report and any response to such report from the department and correctional health services on the website of the board
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 30 days after the board submits the report to the department and correctional health services
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post statements on the website every 60 days when an investigation of an incarcerated individual's death has not been concluded within 180 days of the death.
obligations.quote: where the board has not concluded an investigation of a death of an incarcerated individual pursuant to this subdivision within 180 days of such death, the board shall, every 60 days until the board concludes such investigation and posts a report about such investigation, post on its website a statement that the board has not concluded such investigation
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide records provided by the department and correctional health services to the next of kin of deceased incarcerated individuals upon request, in accordance with the Public Officers Law.
obligations.quote: Upon request from the next of kin of an incarcerated individual who has died, the board shall provide to such next of kin records provided to the board by the department and correctional health services for purposes of such investigation in accordance with section 87 of the public officers law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Notify the office of chief medical examiner and the board of correction as soon as practicable, but no later than 3 hours, after becoming aware of a death of an incarcerated individual in custody.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify the office of chief medical examiner and the board of correction as soon as practicable after becoming aware of a death of an incarcerated individual in the custody of the department, other than any such individual who the department has released pursuant to the work release program, provided that the department shall notify such office and such board no later than 3 hours after becoming aware of such death.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 3 hours after becoming aware of such death
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Make a good faith effort to notify the attorney of a deceased incarcerated individual as soon as practicable after notifying next of kin, but no later than 24 hours after notifying next of kin, or if unable to notify next of kin within 48 hours, notify the attorney within 48 hours.
obligations.quote: The department shall make a good faith effort to notify the attorney of an incarcerated individual who has died as soon as practicable after notifying the next of kin of such individual as described in subdivision c of this section, provided the department shall notify such attorney no later than 24 hours after notifying such next of kin, and provided further that, where the department is unable to notify such next of kin within 48 hours after becoming aware of such death, the department shall notify the attorney of such death.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 24 hours after notifying such next of kin
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Document notification efforts to next of kin including the name of the employee, the next of kin's identity and relationship, the means of communication, and the date and time of notification, and utilize interpretation services where applicable.
obligations.quote: The department shall document any efforts of the department to notify the next of kin of such incarcerated individual pursuant to section 3-10 of title 40 of the rules of the city of New York, and shall include the name of the employee of the department who notified or attempted to notify the next of kin, the name of the next of kin such employee notified or attempted to notify, the means of communication the department used for such notification or attempt to notify, the next of kin's relationship to the deceased incarcerated individual, and the time and date that the department notified or attempted to notify the next of kin. Where applicable, the department shall utilize interpretation services pursuant to section 23-1102 for purposes of notifying a next of kin of a deceased incarcerated individual.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Notify the board of correction that the next of kin of a deceased incarcerated individual has been notified of the death.
obligations.quote: The department shall notify the board of correction that the department has notified the next of kin of a death of an incarcerated individual pursuant to subdivision c of this section, after the department notifies such next of kin of such death.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post notification about a death on the department's website no later than 24 hours after notifying the next of kin, office of chief medical examiner, and board of correction, including name, age, race, gender, and facility, with exceptions if next of kin notification delayed.
obligations.quote: No later than 24 hours after notifying the next of kin of the incarcerated individual, the office of chief medical examiner, and the board of correction pursuant to this section, the department shall post a notification about such death on the department's website. Such notification shall include the name, age, race, and gender of the incarcerated individual who has died, and the facility to which the department assigned such individual, where applicable, provided that where the department is unable to notify the next of kin of an incarcerated individual who has died within 24 hours of becoming aware of such death, such notification shall not include the name, age, or race of the incarcerated individual who has died
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 24 hours after notifying the next of kin of the incarcerated individual, the office of chief medical examiner, and the board of correction
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Update website notifications to include the name, age, and race of a deceased incarcerated individual no later than 24 hours after notifying the next of kin, if such information was initially withheld.
obligations.quote: department shall update any such notification to include the name, age, and race of the incarcerated individual who has died no later than 24 hours after the department notifies the next of kin of such individual.
obligations.deadline_text: no later than 24 hours after the department notifies the next of kin of such individual
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Request that correctional health services provide contact information for a family member of an incarcerated individual whose next of kin is not known.
obligations.quote: where the department is not aware of the next of kin of an incarcerated individual who has died, the department shall request that correctional health services provide contact information for a family member of such incarcerated individual included in the medical record of such individual
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Post information on the department's website about how next of kin may obtain personal items of deceased incarcerated individuals and provide assistance in obtaining such items.
obligations.quote: The department shall post on the department's website information about how the next of kin of an incarcerated individual who has died may obtain such individual's personal items, in accordance with applicable law and department policy, and to the extent practicable, shall provide assistance to such next of kin in obtaining such items.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Not dispose of personal items of deceased incarcerated individuals except in accordance with applicable law.
obligations.quote: The department shall not dispose of any such personal items except in accordance with applicable law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to any recommendations in the department of investigation's report about a death, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and reasons if not.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report by the department of investigation about such death, including to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such a recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to any recommendations in the board of correction's report about a death posted on the board's website, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and reasons if not.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report about such death the board of correction posts pursuant to subdivision i of section 626 of the charter to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on the department's website a report on any employee under investigation for misconduct related to a death no later than 30 days after the board posts its report and any investigation by the attorney general is completed.
obligations.quote: No later than 30 days after (i) the board of correction posts a report about an investigation by such board of a death of an incarcerated individual held or confined under the jurisdiction of the department pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision i of section 626 of the charter, and (ii) where the attorney general commences an investigation such death, such attorney general completes such investigation, the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and shall post on the department's website a report regarding any employee under investigation by the department for any misconduct in relation to such death.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 30 days after (i) the board of correction posts a report about an investigation by such board of a death of an incarcerated individual held or confined under the jurisdiction of the department pursuant to paragraph 2 of subdivision i of section 626 of the charter, and (ii) where the attorney general commences an investigation such death, such attorney general completes such investigation
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Redact identifying information and information prohibited from disclosure before submitting or posting reports on employee investigations related to deaths.
obligations.quote: Before submitting such a report to the mayor or the speaker of the council or posting such report on the website of the department, the department shall redact any identifying information or any information prohibited from disclosure under federal or state law.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit updates to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on the department's website updated reports on employee investigations no less than once every 60 days until the investigation concludes.
obligations.quote: The department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and shall post on the department's website an update to any report required by this subdivision no less than once each 60 days until the department concludes such investigation.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide contact information for a family member of an incarcerated individual who died when requested by the department and whose next of kin is not known.
obligations.quote: correctional health services shall provide such information to the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to any recommendations in the department of investigation's report about a death, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and reasons if not.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report by the department of investigation about such death, including to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such a recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Respond to any recommendations in the board of correction's report about a death, stating whether recommendations will be implemented and reasons if not.
obligations.quote: the department or correctional health services shall respond to any recommendation included in any report about such death the board of correction posts pursuant to subdivision i of section 626 of the charter to state whether the department or correctional health services has determined to implement such recommendation and, where the department or correctional health services has determined not to implement such recommendation, the reasons for such determination.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Provide staff for the prison death review board.
obligations.quote: The board of correction shall provide staff for the prison death review board
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Keep a record of any meetings or other proceedings of the prison death review board.
obligations.quote: The prison death review board shall keep a record of any meetings or any other proceedings of such board.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to procedures following the death of an individual in custody of the department of correction

obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on the contracted entity's website a community impact report for economic development projects.
obligations.quote: Each covered contract executed on or after the effective date of the local law that added this section shall require a contracted entity to submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on the website of such contracted entity a community impact report
obligations.deadline_text: no less than 15 days before (i) the execution of an agreement between such contracted entity and the person or entity that undertakes an economic development project for the provision of an economic development benefit for such project, or (ii) the conveyance of title of such project from such contracted entity to such person or entity, whichever is later
affected_groups: persons or entities undertaking economic development projects
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the posting of community impact reports for city-subsidized economic development projects

obligations.action_summary: Enforce compliance with color and artwork requirements for parapet panels on sidewalk sheds at construction sites, including acceptance of solid colors (hunter green, metallic gray, white, or façade-matching colors) or artwork displays.
obligations.citation: NYC Building Code § 3307.6.4.11, as amended by Section 1 of this local law
obligations.quote: Parapet panels shall be a solid acceptable color, or display artwork pursuant to Section 3307.11.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city building code, in relation to requiring a solid acceptable color or the display of artwork on temporary protective structures on construction sites

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing the installation and location of natural gas alarms and devices in residential buildings.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York and the New York city building code, in relation to deadlines for installing natural gas detectors and to repeal section 908.10 of the building code relating thereto

obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2026

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Remove or cause to be removed any vehicle, box, barrel, bale of merchandise, or other movable property or article found upon any street.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall remove[,] or cause to be removed any vehicle, box, barrel, bale of merchandise, or other movable property or article or thing whatsoever found upon any street
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to vehicles reported as abandoned to the department of sanitation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Within 24 hours of identification or report of an abandoned vehicle, determine if such vehicle is an abandoned vehicle as described in subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law.

obligations.deadline_text: Within 24 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to vehicles reported as abandoned to the department of sanitation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Within 72 hours of identification or report of an abandoned vehicle, remove or cause to be removed such vehicle from the street if it qualifies as an abandoned vehicle under vehicle and traffic law and its VIN is not ascertainable.
obligations.quote: Within 72 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report, remove or cause to be removed such vehicle from such street, provided that such vehicle is an abandoned vehicle described by subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law and the vehicle identification number of such vehicle is not ascertainable by such department
obligations.deadline_text: Within 72 hours of the department making such identification or receiving such report
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to vehicles reported as abandoned to the department of sanitation

obligations.action_summary: Post on its website information regarding the use of indoor basketball courts, including how to access indoor basketball courts under the jurisdiction of the department of education that may be used by basketball leagues on days when weather does not allow for the use of outdoor basketball courts.
obligations.quote: The department shall post on its website information regarding the use of indoor basketball courts, including, but not limited to, how to access, in accordance with department of education policy, indoor basketball courts under the jurisdiction of the department of education
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the posting of information on the use of indoor basketball courts, and a study on improving access to indoor basketball courts

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the posting of information on the use of indoor basketball courts, and a study on improving access to indoor basketball courts

obligations.actor_raw: the department of parks and recreation

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the posting of information on the use of indoor basketball courts, and a study on improving access to indoor basketball courts

obligations.quote: the department of education, in consultation with the department and the school construction authority, shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report about playgrounds to which the department of education may provide access to the public after school on weekdays when school is in session, and from 8:00 a.m. to dusk on weekends and on weekdays when school is not in session
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 75 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation

obligations.quote: allow commercial vehicles to park for at least 10 continuous hours, except that these overnight parking areas shall not be active between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of curbside overnight truck parking in industrial business zones and to provide for the repeal thereof

obligations.action_summary: Prohibit non-commercial vehicles from parking in overnight parking areas during hours when commercial vehicles are allowed to park.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of curbside overnight truck parking in industrial business zones and to provide for the repeal thereof

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of curbside overnight truck parking in industrial business zones and to provide for the repeal thereof

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council, and publish on the department's website, an annual report on the use of overnight parking areas in industrial business zones including location, usage data, and assessment of effects.

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Remove any abandoned vehicle described by subdivision 2 of section 1224 of the vehicle and traffic law from any street.

obligations.committee: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
obligations.action_summary: Adopt rules relating to leasing of yards for storage, notification to owners, redemption of property, reimbursement of removal expenses, sale of property, keeping of records and accounts, transmission of records to the comptroller, transmission of funds to the commissioner of finance, and other necessary regulations.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall adopt rules relating to: 1. The leasing of yards for storage of property removed under the authority of this section; 2. Notification to the owner of the property removed, if such owner is ascertainable, that the property is being held by the commissioner; 3. Redemption, by the owner, of the property removed; 4. Reimbursement, by the owner, of the expenses of removal incurred by the commissioner; 5. The sale, by the commissioner, of the property held by the commissioner; 6. The keeping of records and accounts, the transmission of such records to the comptroller, and the transmission of funds collected to the commissioner of finance; and 7. Such other rules as the commissioner may deem necessary to carry out the provisions of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to removal of derelict vehicles

obligations.deadline_text: no later than June 1, 2035
obligations.law_title: A Local Law in relation to requiring the installation of outdoor drinking fountains near entrances to parks under the jurisdiction of the department of parks and recreation

obligations.action_summary: Submit an update regarding the status of each active or planned capital project to install a public bathroom at locations identified in the 2022 report, including project descriptions, timelines, funding, and maintenance strategies.
obligations.quote: An update regarding the status of each active or planned capital project to install a public bathroom at a location identified in the report submitted pursuant to local law number 114 for the year 2022, including, as applicable: (a) A description of such project, including a description of the factors that led to the identification of the site, the proposed type of facility to be installed, and proposed safety measures; (b) The actual or estimated starting date and actual or estimated completion date of the current phase of such project, and upon completion of the project, the estimated useful life of the facility; (c) The total amount of funds allocated to such project or, when applicable, a range of the funds available for such project; (d) Each source of funding allocated to such project; (e) For each public bathroom that is completed, a description of the strategy for maintaining sanitary conditions and operation; and (f) The location of such project, including the borough and community district where such project is located
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to reporting on previously identified sites for public bathrooms

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of correction to make available opioid antagonists in housing units and to provide opioid antagonist training for correction officers

obligations.quote: No less than once each week, the department shall verify and document that opioid antagonists are available in such areas for use by uniformed staff and incarcerated individuals.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of correction to make available opioid antagonists in housing units and to provide opioid antagonist training for correction officers

obligations.action_summary: Post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council, the mayor, and the public advocate an annual report on uniformed staff trained, percentage trained, and incidents of opioid antagonist administration, disaggregated by facility.

obligations.deadline_text: No later than April 1, 2026, and no later than April 1 of each year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of correction to make available opioid antagonists in housing units and to provide opioid antagonist training for correction officers
