obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to tracking progress made towards the requirements of the streets master plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Post and update information about each benchmark project identifying funding sources, total or range of allocated funds, and funds already expended.
obligations.quote: Information about the funding for the benchmark project including identification of whether the funding comes from a city or non-city source, the total amount of funds allocated to such benchmark project or, when applicable, a range of the amount of funds available for such benchmark project, and the amount of funds already expended
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to tracking progress made towards the requirements of the streets master plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Post and update publicly available information about contractors and vendors providing services on each benchmark project and all procurements and contracts associated with the project.
obligations.quote: Publicly available information about contractors or other vendors providing services on the benchmark project, and on all procurements and contracts associated with such project, or a link to a website where such publicly available information may be found
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to tracking progress made towards the requirements of the streets master plan

obligations.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
obligations.action_summary: Post and update information about each benchmark project identifying any actual cost overruns for each phase and the reasons for such overruns.
obligations.quote: Any actual cost overruns for each phase of the benchmark project, and the reason for such cost overrun.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to tracking progress made towards the requirements of the streets master plan

obligations.action_summary: Provide to persons submitting tree pruning complaints or service requests a link to the map required by section 18-157, a link to the department of parks and recreation website page with tree pruning information and maps, and information about a volunteer tree pruning training and certification program.
obligations.quote: The 311 customer service center, in consultation with the department of parks and recreation, shall provide to any person who submits a complaint or request for service relating to the pruning of any tree under the jurisdiction of the department of parks and recreation: 1. A link to the map required by paragraph 5 of subdivision c of section 18-157; 2. A link to a page of the website of the department of parks and recreation that includes information about tree pruning and a map showing completed and scheduled tree pruning activities by such department; and 3. Information or resources about a program to train and certify volunteers in the pruning of trees.
affected_groups: persons submitting tree pruning complaints or service requests
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the 311 customer service center to provide certain resources in response to tree pruning-related requests

obligations.action_summary: Develop guidance for facilitating safe evacuation before flash flood emergencies, including information on avoiding flash flood dangers, evacuation procedures, and refuge facilities.
obligations.quote: The office shall develop guidance for facilitating safe evacuation before flash flood emergencies. Such guidance shall include but need not be limited to: (i) information on how residents may avoid the dangers of flash flooding events; (ii) guidance on how and when to safely evacuate a location prone to flash flooding prior to a flash flood event, and (iii) existing public or private facilities suitable for individuals seeking refuge
obligations.deadline_text: within one year of the enactment of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Include flash flood preparedness guidance in the office's annual report.
obligations.quote: Such guidance shall be included in the office's annual report within one year of the enactment of the local law that added this section.
obligations.deadline_text: within one year of the enactment of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Establish an outreach program to increase Notify NYC alert registration and coordinate efforts across agencies to increase public awareness regarding appropriate responses to flash flood risks, including evacuation planning.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall establish an outreach program to increase registration for Notify NYC alerts and to coordinate efforts across agencies to increase public awareness regarding the appropriate responses by members of the public to flash flood risks, including evacuation planning established pursuant to subdivision b of this section.
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Distribute emergency preparedness materials and information through in-person distribution, mass mail, and guidance for building and property owners to locations prone to flash floods.
obligations.quote: Such program shall include the distribution of emergency preparedness materials and information in-person, and distribution through mass mail, guidance for building and property owners, and any other means the commissioner deems appropriate for locations prone to flash floods.
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Include in the annual report details of the outreach program, including the locations selected for outreach based on flash flood history and prevalence of basement or cellar dwellings.
obligations.quote: Within 1 year of the enactment of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter, the office shall include in their annual report the details of the outreach program established by subdivision c, including the locations selected for outreach.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 1 year of the enactment of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A local law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to flash flood preparedness outreach and evacuation guidance
obligations.committee: Committee on Fire and Emergency Management

obligations.action_summary: Develop criteria, including a rating system, for prioritization of maintenance of trees under the commissioner's jurisdiction that are adjacent to buildings or other structures.
obligations.quote: The department shall develop criteria, including a rating system, for the prioritization for maintenance of any tree that is: (i) under the jurisdiction of the commissioner; and (ii) adjacent to a building or other structure.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prioritization of maintenance of trees adjacent to buildings and structures

obligations.action_summary: Post on its website the criteria developed for tree maintenance prioritization and information about the development of such criteria.
obligations.quote: The department shall post on its website the criteria developed in subdivision a and information about the development of such criteria.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prioritization of maintenance of trees adjacent to buildings and structures

obligations.agency: a deputy mayor designated by the mayor or any other agency or office designated by such mayor
obligations.agency_full: a deputy mayor designated by the mayor or any other agency or office designated by such mayor
obligations.action_summary: File a strategic planning report with the mayor, speaker, public advocate, borough presidents, and community boards to establish and maintain a citywide public bathroom network meeting or exceeding a target metric of at least 2,120 public bathrooms.
obligations.quote: No later than September 1, 2026, and every fourth year thereafter, the relevant agency shall file with the mayor, the speaker of the council, the public advocate, each borough president, and each community board a strategic planning report to establish and maintain a citywide public bathroom network.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than September 1, 2026, and every fourth year thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a long-term citywide bathroom strategy and to make other technical changes
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.actor_raw: an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency: an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.agency_full: an agency or office designated by the mayor
obligations.action_summary: Post or update on its website and make accessible on a mobile device a map of existing and planned public bathrooms with specified information including hours of operation, repair status, accessibility, fees, responsible maintenance entities, planned opening dates, and design features.
obligations.quote: Upon the submission of the report required by subdivision b of this section, an agency or office designated by the mayor shall post or update on its website and make compatible for access on a mobile device a map of existing and planned public bathrooms.
obligations.deadline_text: Upon the submission of the report required by subdivision b of this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a long-term citywide bathroom strategy and to make other technical changes
obligations.committee: Committee on Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation

obligations.action_summary: Waive the civil service examination fee for high school students who provide verifiable identification and for first-time applicants who have not previously filed for a civil service examination.
obligations.quote: The department may waive the fee for a civil service examination for any individual who meets one of the following conditions at the time of filing for the examination: 1. The individual is a high school student who provides a verifiable form of identification; or 2. The individual has not previously filed for a civil service examination administered by the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to civil service examination fee waivers for high school students and first time applicants
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

obligations.action_summary: Propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website at least 90 days prior to the use of any new and distinct surveillance technology.
obligations.quote: The department shall propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website, at least 90 days prior to the use of any new and distinct surveillance technology.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Update an existing impact and use policy to describe a new, but not distinct, surveillance technology that has the same function but substantially differs in form or has a different manufacturer or product name.
obligations.quote: The department shall update an existing impact and use policy to describe a new, but not distinct, surveillance technology, which has the same function but substantially differs in form or has a different manufacturer or product name.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website for existing surveillance technology.
obligations.quote: For existing surveillance technology as of the effective date of the local law that added this section, the department shall propose a surveillance technology impact and use policy and post such proposal on the department's website within 180 days of such effective date.
obligations.deadline_text: within 180 days of such effective date
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide an addendum to the existing surveillance technology impact and use policy when acquiring enhancements to surveillance technology or using such surveillance technology for a purpose or in a manner not previously disclosed.
obligations.quote: When the department seeks to acquire or acquires enhancements to surveillance technology or uses such surveillance technology for a purpose or in a manner not previously disclosed through the surveillance technology impact and use policy, the department shall provide an addendum to the existing surveillance technology impact and use policy describing such enhancement or additional use.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Consider public comments and provide the final surveillance technology impact and use policy to the speaker and the mayor, and post it on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall consider public comments and provide the final surveillance technology impact and use policy to the speaker and the mayor, and shall post it on the department's website no more than 45 days after the close of the public comment period established by subdivision e of this section.
obligations.deadline_text: no more than 45 days after the close of the public comment period
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Create an internal tracking system that documents each instance in which the department provides an external entity with data collected using a surveillance technology.
obligations.quote: Within 270 days of the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision, the department shall create an internal tracking system that complies with this subdivision.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 270 days of the effective date of the local law that added this subdivision
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Develop an internal tracking system listing each local, state, or federal government agency that has direct access to data collected by the department using surveillance technology and the extent of such access.
obligations.quote: the department shall develop an internal tracking system listing each local, state, or federal government agency that has direct access to data collected by the department using surveillance technology and the extent of the data to which the agency has direct access and for which dates the agency has direct access.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Develop a policy regarding the circumstances under which any local, state, or federal government agency has access to data collected by the department using surveillance technology.
obligations.quote: The department shall develop a policy regarding the circumstances under which any local, state, or federal government agency has access to data collected by the department using surveillance technology.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a review of evidence of physical safety hazards posed by surveillance technologies used by the department and include any identified physical hazards in the surveillance technology impact and use policy.
obligations.quote: Within 270 days of the local law that added this section and annually thereafter, the department shall conduct a review of evidence of physical safety hazards posed by surveillance technologies used by the department, including but not limited to evaluations by experts in the field, and shall include any identified physical hazards in the surveillance technology impact and use policy.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 270 days of the local law that added this section and annually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.actor_raw: the New York city police department
obligations.action_summary: Update and publish new surveillance technology impact and use policies to bring existing impact and use policies into compliance with this local law.
obligations.quote: within 270 days of the effective date of this local law, the New York city police department shall update and publish new surveillance technology impact and use policies to bring existing impact and use policies into compliance with this local law
obligations.deadline_text: within 270 days of the effective date of this local law
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to police department transparency in the use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Create and post on its website a written policy establishing procedures for the department's use of facial recognition technologies.
obligations.quote: The department shall create and post on its website a written policy that establishes procedures for the department's use of facial recognition technologies.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a police department policy for using facial recognition technology and regular audits to ensure compliance

obligations.action_summary: Conduct an annual audit of its use of facial recognition technology, document it, provide it to the department of investigation, and publish it on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The department shall conduct an annual audit of its use of facial recognition technology. Such audit shall be documented and provided to the department of investigation and published on the department's website.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the establishment of a police department policy for using facial recognition technology and regular audits to ensure compliance

obligations.action_summary: Provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access to an itemized list of all surveillance technologies used, including specifications of functionality, types of data collected, and which department unit maintains control of information collected.
obligations.quote: the department shall provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access to the following information: 1. an itemized list of all surveillance technologies used by the department, including specifications of the functionality of each such technology, the types of data collected by each such technology, and which department unit maintains control of information collected by each such technology
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of investigation's oversight of the police department use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access to any access and retention policies for data collected by surveillance technologies used by the department, including policies included in contracts with surveillance technology vendors.
obligations.quote: the department shall provide the commissioner of investigation with prompt access to the following information: 2. any access and retention policies for data collected by surveillance technologies used by the department, including any access and retention policies included in contracts with entities from which the department procures such surveillance technologies.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of investigation's oversight of the police department use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide the commissioner of investigation with a list of all surveillance technologies acquired or discontinued during the prior six months and all access and retention policies for data collected by such technologies from vendor contracts.
obligations.quote: the department shall provide the commissioner of investigation with a list of all surveillance technologies that were acquired by the department, or which the department discontinued using, during the prior six months, and all access and retention policies for data collected by such surveillance technologies included in any executed contracts with entities from which the department procured such surveillance technology during the prior six months.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2025, and semiannually thereafter
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the department of investigation's oversight of the police department use of surveillance technology

obligations.action_summary: Provide access to benefits and services to every person with HIV who requests assistance.
obligations.quote: There shall be a division [of AIDS services] within the New York city department of social services[. Such division shall] to provide access to benefits and services, as defined in section 21-128(a)(1) [of this chapter], to every person [with clinical/symptomatic HIV illness, as determined by the New York state department of health AIDS institute, or with AIDS, as defined by the federal centers for disease control and prevention,] with HIV who requests assistance
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Direct staff of the division to provide intensive case management with specified caseworker-to-client ratios and transportation and nutrition allowances to persons with HIV satisfying medicaid income eligibility requirements.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall direct staff of the division [of AIDS services] established pursuant to section 21-126 to provide to persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness, as determined by the New York state department of health AIDS institute, or persons with AIDS, as defined by the federal centers for disease control and prevention,] HIV who satisfy the income eligibility requirements for medicaid as set forth in section 1396 et. seq. of title 42 of the United States code: (i) intensive case management with an average ratio which shall not exceed [one] 1 caseworker or supervisor to [twenty-five] 25 family cases, and with an overall average ratio for all cases which shall not exceed [one] 1 caseworker or supervisor to [thirty-four] 34 cases; and (ii) transportation and nutrition allowances.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Establish criteria within 30 days of effective date pursuant to which an applicant shall be entitled to a home or hospital visit for the purpose of establishing eligibility and applying for benefits and services.
obligations.quote: Within [thirty] 30 days of the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall establish criteria pursuant to which an applicant shall be entitled to a home or hospital visit for the purpose of establishing eligibility and applying for benefits and services.
obligations.deadline_text: Within [thirty] 30 days of the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide every person with HIV who applies for benefits and services with a receipt on the day of application or submission of documents, including date, description of information received, and statement of completeness.
obligations.quote: Upon written or oral application to the division for benefits and services or submission of documents required to establish eligibility for benefits and services by a person with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV, such person shall immediately be provided with a receipt which shall include, but not be limited to, the date, a description of the information received, and a statement as to whether any application for such benefits and services is complete or incomplete, and if incomplete, such receipt shall identify any information or documents needed in order for the application to be deemed complete.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide every homeless client determined eligible for services with an application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing and information regarding financial assistance and housing options on the day eligibility is determined.
obligations.quote: Unless the client shall decline, the division shall provide the following to every homeless client of the division on the day the client is determined to be eligible for services as a client of the division: [(i)] (1) an application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing; and [(ii)] (2) information regarding financial assistance available to assist eligible clients in obtaining housing and regarding available housing options.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Ensure every client receives assistance needed to complete the application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing within 10 business days of the day the client is determined eligible for division services.
obligations.quote: The division shall ensure that every client receives any assistance needed to complete the application for medically appropriate non-emergency housing within 10 business days of the day on which the client is determined to be eligible for services as a client of the division.
obligations.deadline_text: within 10 business days of the day on which the client is determined to be eligible for services as a client of the division
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide every client eligible for non-emergency housing with a referral to an available medically appropriate non-emergency housing option within 90 days of initial placement in emergency housing or completion of physical documentation, whichever is sooner.
obligations.quote: Within 90 days of initial placement in emergency housing or of completion of the physical documentation required from the client for the application for non-emergency housing, whichever is sooner, the division must provide every client who is eligible for non-emergency housing a referral to an available medically appropriate non-emergency housing option, which takes into consideration the medical, educational and familial needs and social circumstances of the client, to the extent such option is available.
obligations.deadline_text: Within 90 days of initial placement in emergency housing or of completion of the physical documentation required from the client for the application for non-emergency housing, whichever is sooner
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide a referral to another medically appropriate non-emergency housing option for any client who remains homeless or in emergency housing for over 45 days after housing referral requirements have been met.
obligations.quote: For any client who remains homeless or in emergency housing for over 45 days after the requirements of subparagraph (c) of this paragraph or the requirements of this subparagraph have been met, the division shall provide a referral to another medically appropriate non-emergency housing option, to the extent such option is available.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a draft policy and procedures manual for division staff within 60 days of effective date, including guidelines on confidentiality, medical/psychological needs, application procedures, eligibility standards, mandated time periods for benefits and services, and advocacy resources.
obligations.quote: [Not] No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall prepare a draft policy and procedures manual for division staff. Such policy and procedures manual shall include, but not be limited to, strict guidelines on maintaining the confidentiality of the identity of and information relating to all applicants and recipients, instructional materials relating to the medical and psychological needs of persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV, application procedures, eligibility standards, mandated time periods for the provision of each benefit and service available to applicants and recipients and advocacy resources available to persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Update the list of advocacy resources in the policy and procedures manual on a semi-annual basis.
obligations.quote: Such list of advocacy resources shall be updated semi-annually.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Distribute the draft policy and procedures manual to contracted social service agencies and other appropriate entities within 30 days of preparation and hold at least one noticed public hearing at an accessible site before preparing the final manual.
obligations.quote: Within [thirty] 30 days following the preparation of such draft policy and procedure manual and prior to the preparation of a final policy and procedures manual, the commissioner shall distribute such draft policy and procedure manual to all social service agencies and organizations that contract with the department to provide HIV-related services and to all others whom the commissioner deems appropriate, and hold no fewer than [one] 1 noticed public hearing at a site accessible to [the disabled] individuals with disabilities, at which advocates, service providers, persons who have tested positive for HIV, and any other member of the public shall be given an opportunity to comment on such draft policy and procedures manual.
obligations.deadline_text: Within [thirty] 30 days following the preparation of such draft policy and procedure manual
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Prepare a final policy and procedures manual within 30 days after conclusion of the public hearing and thereafter review and revise on an annual basis.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall prepare a final policy and procedures manual within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing and shall thereafter review and where appropriate, revise such policy and procedures manual on an annual basis.
obligations.deadline_text: within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Provide semi-annual training to all division staff using the policy and procedures manual.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide for semi-annual training, using such policy and procedures manual, for all division staff.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Publish a proposed rule establishing a bill of rights for persons with HIV within 60 days of effective date, including benefits and services, timetables, file examination rights, home/hospital visit rights, hearing process, and anti-discrimination remedies.
obligations.quote: [Not] No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall publish a proposed rule establishing a bill of rights for persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV. Such draft bill of rights shall include, but not be limited to, an explanation of the benefits and services for which persons with [clinical/symptomatic HIV illness or with AIDS] HIV may be eligible; timetables within which such benefits and services shall be provided to eligible persons; an explanation of an applicant's and recipient's right to examine [his or her] such applicant's and recipient's file and the procedure for disputing any information contained therein; an explanation of an applicant's and recipient's right to a home or hospital visit for the purpose of applying for or maintaining benefits or services; an explanation of the process for requesting a division conference or New York state fair hearing; and a summary of the rights and remedies for the redress of discrimination as provided for in title [eight of this code] 8.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than [sixty] 60 days from the effective date of the local law that added this section
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Hold at least one noticed public hearing at an accessible site within 60 days following publication of the proposed bill of rights rule, allowing advocates, service providers, persons with HIV, and the public to comment.
obligations.quote: Within [sixty] 60 days following the publication of such proposed rule, and prior to the publication of a final rule, the commissioner shall hold no fewer than [one] 1 noticed public hearing at a site accessible to [the disabled] individuals with disabilities at which advocates, service providers, persons who have tested positive for HIV, and any other member of the public shall be given an opportunity to comment on such draft bill of rights.
obligations.deadline_text: Within [sixty] 60 days following the publication of such proposed rule
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Publish a final bill of rights rule within 30 days after conclusion of the public hearing and thereafter review and revise on an annual basis.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall publish a final rule within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing and shall thereafter review, and where appropriate, revise such bill of rights on an annual basis.
obligations.deadline_text: within [thirty] 30 days after the conclusion of such hearing
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Post the bill of rights conspicuously in all division offices open to the public and make available for distribution in English, Spanish, and any other languages deemed appropriate.
obligations.quote: Such bill of rights shall be conspicuously posted in all division offices that are open to the public and shall be available for distribution to the public in English, Spanish and any other languages that the commissioner deems appropriate.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of services to people living with HIV and AIDS

obligations.action_summary: Establish a policy or procedure for overseeing and monitoring the delivery of services to persons with HIV within 90 days of effective date, including quality assurance measurements.

obligations.quote: The department shall provide to staff access to mental health resources relating to reducing stress and other adverse mental health impacts for persons working in correctional facilities. In providing such access, the department shall consider guidance and any best practices established by the national institute of corrections. Such resources shall include, but need not be limited to, confidential mental health counseling to address the impacts of sexual assault of staff and sexual harassment of staff.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of correction to report on sexual assault and sexual harassment of correctional staff and providing staff access to mental health treatment resources

obligations.action_summary: Provide information about the availability of mental health resources on the department's website, electronically communicate such information to staff, and post such information in conspicuous locations in department facilities.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide information about the availability of such resources on the department's website. The commissioner shall electronically communicate such information to staff, and shall post such information in conspicuous locations in facilities of the department.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the department of correction to report on sexual assault and sexual harassment of correctional staff and providing staff access to mental health treatment resources

obligations.quote: On the date on which an employee commences employment at an agency, such agency shall provide the following information to such employee in clear and plain language: 1. Information regarding the availability of city-administered benefits; 2. Any required actions such employee must take to enroll in such city-administered benefits, including any relevant deadlines; 3. Any required actions such employee must take to maintain such city-administered benefits, to the extent such employee transfers employment from one agency to a different agency, without any interruption in service, including any relevant deadlines; 4. The names and contact information of persons at the agency where such employee commences employment who provide guidance to employees regarding accessing city-administered benefits; 5. The names and contact information of persons at the agency where such employee commences employment who provide personnel services, including the type of guidance such persons are designated to provide; and 6. To the extent such agency provides any information to such employee regarding available employee benefits that are not city-administered benefits, contact information for persons who can provide guidance to such employees regarding such benefits, to the extent such contact information is available.

obligations.action_summary: Conduct a study on the feasibility of creating or designating older adult information points within existing older adult centers, identifying potential locations in each borough, locational considerations, assistance and resources, potential benefits, potential constraints, and estimates of older adults served per location.
obligations.quote: The department shall study the feasibility of creating older adult information points or designating older adult information points within existing older adult centers. Such study shall: 1. Identify potential locations in each borough for the creation of older adult information points; 2. Identify considerations for locating older adult information points, such as the accessibility of the proposed location and proximity to older adult centers, naturally occurring retirement communities, neighborhood naturally occurring retirement communities, commercial districts, and mass transit; 3. Identify assistance and resources that could be provided to older adults at older adult information points, such as assistance with applications for services and benefits and information on services and programming provided through the department and older adult centers; 4. Assess the potential benefits of establishing older adult information points; 5. Assess potential constraints on the establishment of older adult information points, including the resources needed to establish and staff each such facility; and 6. For each older adult information point, (i) estimate how many older adults would be served and (ii) list the boroughs, council districts, and neighborhoods that would be served.

Such report shall state the date of publication. If the department determines through the study that the creation of older adult information points would be feasible or infeasible, the department shall include a statement in the report explaining its reasons for either such determination.

obligations.deadline_text: no later than June 19, 2028

obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.action_summary: Select a minimum of 5 sites, including at least 1 in each borough, to establish public forums for truth and reconciliation proceedings, giving priority consideration to accessible sites with good transportation, capacity, and topical relevance.
obligations.quote: CORE, in consultation with community stakeholders, shall select a minimum of 5 sites on which to establish public forums for truth and reconciliation proceedings, as follows: 1. CORE shall select a minimum of 1 site in each borough.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.action_summary: List the location, schedule of meetings, and topic or topics to be addressed at each public forum on its website, and publish materials, video recordings, public testimony, and other research from each public forum on its website as they become available.
obligations.quote: CORE shall list the location, schedule of meetings, and topic or topics to be addressed at each public forum on its website, and to the extent feasible publish materials, video recordings, public testimony, and other research from each public forum on its website
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.quote: Beginning no later than July 1, 2025, and ending no earlier than 365 days after the conclusion of the truth and reconciliation process required by this chapter, CORE, in consultation with the civic engagement commission, the commission on human rights, and the office of ethnic and community media, shall conduct a public outreach and information campaign
obligations.deadline_text: Beginning no later than July 1, 2025
affected_groups: persons of different ages and backgrounds
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

CORE shall describe these terms and guidelines, as well as any relevant training needs, in the plan required pursuant to subdivision b of section 34-201
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.action_summary: Post public notice of the time and place of meetings, hearings, and other proceedings relating to truth and reconciliation, scheduled at least 30 days in advance when practicable, including notice to news media, conspicuous posting in public locations, and posting on CORE's website.
obligations.quote: CORE shall post public notice of the time and place of meetings, hearings, and other proceedings of CORE in which it is planned to address matters relating to truth and reconciliation. Wherever practicable, such proceedings shall be scheduled and publicly noticed at least 30 days in advance, or within 2 days of when the meeting was scheduled, whichever is earlier.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.action_summary: Publish a report documenting findings of the truth and reconciliation process, including experiences and recommendations of participants, and recommending steps to address race-based discrimination and injustice, including proposed steps toward memorialization and recommendations for referral to reparations mechanisms.
obligations.quote: No later than 1 year following the conclusion of the truth and reconciliation process required by this chapter, CORE shall publish a report on the history and legacies of slavery in the city of New York, including but not limited to the legacies and badges of such slavery, if any, that continue to undermine racial equity in the city of New York in the present day.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than 1 year following the conclusion of the truth and reconciliation process
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process
obligations.committee: Committee on Civil and Human Rights

obligations.quote: CORE shall preserve its working documents, videos, transcripts, and operational and administrative records and shall recommend, as part of the report required by section 34-206, a means of memorializing and making available to the public its records and findings for the purpose of public education and engagement in perpetuity.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a truth, healing, and reconciliation process

obligations.quote: Prior to issuing an invitation for bids, request for proposals, or other solicitation, or renewing or amending an existing contract, the agency shall determine whether such contract is the result of or would result in the displacement of any city employee within the agency.

obligations.action_summary: Include a certification signed by the agency head in any solicitation or contract renewal or amendment stating that displacement would not occur, detailing the basis for that determination.
obligations.quote: If the agency determines that displacement would not occur, it shall include a certification to that effect, signed by the agency head, in any invitation for bids, request for proposals, or other solicitation, or with any contract renewal or amendment.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to expanding the application of procurement procedures for certain service contracts, and enhancing public notice requirements for changes to planned contract actions

obligations.action_summary: Immediately upon receipt of bids, proposals, and other solicitation responses, or prior to renewal or amendment of an existing contract, submit the determination, analysis, and supporting documentation to the council and appropriate collective bargaining representatives.
obligations.quote: Immediately upon receipt of bids, proposals, and other solicitation responses, or prior to the renewal or amendment of an existing contract, the agency shall submit such determination, analysis, and supporting documentation to the council and to the appropriate collective bargaining representatives representing employees who would be affected pursuant to paragraph 1 of subdivision a of this section.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to expanding the application of procurement procedures for certain service contracts, and enhancing public notice requirements for changes to planned contract actions

obligations.action_summary: Prior to contract award, renewal, or amendment, perform a comparative analysis of costs and benefits expected from the proposed vendor versus city employees performing the service.

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to expanding the application of procurement procedures for certain service contracts, and enhancing public notice requirements for changes to planned contract actions

obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: Not later than ninety days, sixty days, thirty days and ten days prior to the date of sale of a tax lien or tax liens, the department of finance shall submit to the council a list, disaggregated by council district, of all properties noticed for sale pursuant to paragraph 1 of subdivision b of this section containing the following information for each property on such list: (a) the street address and the borough, block, and lot of such property; (b) the property owners of record; (c) the community board and community board district within which such property is located; (d) the amount that, if paid, would render the tax lien or tax liens on such property ineligible to be sold in accordance with section 11-319 of this chapter; and (e) the sum of the tax lien or tax liens on such property, disaggregated by the amount of the lien arising from the nonpayment of property taxes, the amount of any lien arising from the nonpayment of water and sewer charges, provided that the department of environmental protection has provided such information to the department of finance, the amount of any lien arising from emergency repair program charges, and the amount of any other lien that contributes to the sum of the tax lien or tax liens on the property.
obligations.deadline_text: Not later than ninety days, sixty days, thirty days and ten days prior to the date of sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.deadline_text: No later than one hundred twenty days after the [tax lien] date of sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: the commissioner of finance, in consultation with the commissioner of housing preservation and development and the commissioner of environmental protection, may conduct outreach sessions in the district of such council member, provided, however, that, the commissioner of finance shall conduct such outreach sessions in the ten council districts with the greatest number of properties for which a notice of intention to sell a tax lien has been mailed ninety days prior to the date of sale pursuant to paragraph one of subdivision b of this section, and provided, further, however, that, such commissioner shall conduct additional outreach sessions in the five council districts with the greatest number of properties for which a notice of intention to sell a tax lien has been mailed ninety days prior to the date of sale pursuant to such paragraph.
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale, the commissioner of finance shall submit to the council a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district during the ninety-day period preceding the tax lien sale. Such report shall include: (i) the number of installment agreements begun by property owners or, as defined in subdivision b of section 11-322 of this chapter, other eligible persons, acting on behalf of property owners at each outreach session; (ii) the number of property tax exemption applications begun at each outreach session; (iii) the total number of attendees at each outreach session; (iv) the number of outreach sessions at which a financial counselor was available; (v) the number of property owners, or other eligible persons acting on behalf of property owners, who consulted a financial counselor at each outreach session at which a financial counselor was available; and (vi) the results of such surveys. Such report and the results of each outreach session shall be disaggregated by council district.
obligations.deadline_text: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale
obligations.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the resolution and enforcement of property tax collection and preservation of housing for certain properties

obligations.quote: Beginning July first, two thousand twenty-four, the commissioner of housing preservation and development, in consultation with the commissioner of finance and the commissioner of environmental protection, shall make good faith efforts to establish a procedure to contact the owner of record of any class one property or class two property that is a residential condominium or residential cooperative that has been included in the notice of sale required pursuant to subdivision a of this section, and any other person who has registered pursuant to section 11-309 of this chapter or who has provided notice to the commissioner of finance pursuant to section 11-416 or section 11-417 of this title in relation to such property, to inform them of relevant homeownership counseling and support services that the city, or a not-for-profit organization identified by the commissioner of housing preservation and development, provides and to assist in submitting any application for any exemption, credit or other benefit that would operate to exclude the property from a tax lien sale.
